parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page displayed in a paged query.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries in the result set. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token for the next query. An empty value of NextToken indicates that there is no next page.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. The value is fixed as **instance**.
